ex.en: This species of bird is found only on the island.
ex.zh: 这种鸟仅见于该岛。

words.note: species 单复数同形：a species，many species。

ex.en: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor.
ex.zh: 小心别在湿地板上滑倒。

words.note: slip on 滑倒，slip up 出错，slip of the tongue 口误。

ex.en: The two children have completely different temperaments and interests.
ex.zh: 这两个孩子的性情和兴趣完全不同。

words.note: temperament 指天生性情；temper 更多指脾气。

ex.en: The report cites several studies to support its conclusion.
ex.zh: 报告引用了几项研究来支持其结论。

words.note: cite 指引用作证据，quote 是直接引述原文。

ex.en: I made his acquaintance at a conference last year.
ex.zh: 我去年在一次会议上结识了他。

words.note: acquaintance 指熟人，交情浅于 friend。

ex.en: He is always moaning about the low pay.
ex.zh: 他总在抱怨工资低。

words.note: moan about 是抱怨；groan 多指痛苦的呻吟。

ex.en: A glass of cold water was enough to quench his thirst.
ex.zh: 一杯凉水就足够让他解渴。

words.note: 常搭 quench one's thirst 解渴，也可说 quench a fire。

ex.en: New evidence may shed light on the cause of the fire.
ex.zh: 新证据可能有助于弄清火灾的起因。

words.note: shed light on 意为阐明；shed 的过去式仍是 shed。

ex.en: A little humour can spice up a dull lecture.
ex.zh: 一点幽默就能让枯燥的讲座变得有趣。

words.note: spice up 意为增添趣味；spice 泛指香料。

ex.en: The president's approval rating fell sharply after the scandal.
ex.zh: 丑闻之后总统的支持率大幅下降。

words.note: rating 常用复数表收视率；credit rating 指信用评级。

ex.en: She has learned to be more assertive in meetings.
ex.zh: 她学会了在会上更果断地表达自己。

words.note: assertive 多含褒义，指自信有主见；aggressive 偏咄咄逼人。

ex.en: The region has been autonomous for more than fifty years.
ex.zh: 该地区自治已五十多年。

words.note: auto-（自己）加 nom（法则），即自治的。

ex.en: The referee blew the whistle and ended the match.
ex.zh: 裁判吹响哨子，结束了比赛。

words.note: referee 用于足球、拳击；网球裁判多用 umpire。

ex.en: The aerial view of the city shows how densely it is built.
ex.zh: 城市的鸟瞰图显示出它的建筑密度之高。

words.note: aerial 作名词在英式英语中指天线；aerial view 是鸟瞰。

ex.en: The new drug is still undergoing clinical trials in three hospitals.
ex.zh: 这种新药仍在三家医院进行临床试验。

words.note: trial 表试验常用复数 trials；on trial 指受审或试用中。

ex.en: The media can strongly influence public perception of crime.
ex.zh: 媒体能强烈影响公众对犯罪的看法。

words.note: perception 常与 of 连用；动词是 perceive。

ex.en: Several months elapsed before we heard from him again.
ex.zh: 过了好几个月我们才再次收到他的消息。

words.note: elapse 只用于时间，主语是 time、months、years。

ex.en: The building is admired for the perfect symmetry of its design.
ex.zh: 这座建筑因设计完美对称而备受赞赏。

words.note: sym-（共同）加 metry（测量），形容词是 symmetrical。

ex.en: Try to visualize yourself giving the speech calmly.
ex.zh: 试着想象自己从容地发表演讲。

words.note: visualize 后接动名词或 oneself doing。

ex.en: Companies that invest in training reap the benefits in the long run.
ex.zh: 投资培训的公司在长期中会获得回报。

words.note: reap 本义收割，reap the benefits 是高频搭配。

ex.en: Some insects can cause serious damage to crops.
ex.zh: 有些昆虫会对庄稼造成严重损害。

words.note: insect 可数，泛指时用复数；pest 多指害虫。

ex.en: I presume you have already read the report.
ex.zh: 我想你已经读过这份报告了。

words.note: presume 比 assume 更强调有依据的推断。

ex.en: The two colours complement each other beautifully in this design.
ex.zh: 在这个设计里两种颜色相互映衬得很美。

words.note: complement 是补充使完整，compliment 是赞美。

ex.en: The cable car takes visitors to the top of the mountain.
ex.zh: 缆车把游客送到山顶。

words.note: cable car 缆车，cable TV 有线电视。

ex.en: He developed a nasty habit of interrupting others.
ex.zh: 他养成了打断别人说话的坏习惯。

words.note: nasty 除讨厌外还表严重，如 a nasty fall。

ex.en: The competition for these jobs is extremely intense.
ex.zh: 这些职位的竞争极其激烈。

words.note: intense 指程度强烈；intensive 指密集的。

ex.en: The village lies on the border between the two countries.
ex.zh: 这个村庄位于两国交界处。

words.note: border on 除接壤外还表近乎，如 border on rudeness。

ex.en: He made his fortune in real estate before he was thirty.
ex.zh: 他三十岁前靠房地产发了财。

words.note: real estate 是房地产的固定说法；estate 还指遗产。

ex.en: She is an articulate speaker who can explain complex ideas simply.
ex.zh: 她口才很好，能把复杂观点讲得很简单。

words.note: articulate 作形容词重音在第二音节，作动词指清晰表达。

ex.en: All members must adhere to the club's rules.
ex.zh: 所有会员都必须遵守俱乐部的规定。

words.note: adhere 不及物，须接 to：adhere to the rules 遵守规则。
